title: Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the NAS TFTP service that could allow an…
description: Dell PowerStore SDNAS has a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in its NAS TFTP service. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability is critical with a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
